text_summary: Iran IRGC conducts live-fire naval drill near Strait of Hormuz chokepoint; tanker diversions reported.
OFAC adds three Iranian crude tankers to SDN list; US treasury designates two shipping entities.
AIS data shows 14 VLCCs holding position outside Hormuz approach lanes; transit throughput down ~22%.
Houthi forces claim missile strike on bulk carrier in southern Red Sea; MSC and Maersk suspend transits.
AIS: 32 container vessels rerouting via Cape of Good Hope; Suez northbound lane volume at 18-month low.
Brent crude up 4.3% on open; Red Sea risk premium priced into tanker charter rates (+$120k/day WS).
Egyptian canal authority reports minor vessel grounding; single-lane transit operational, delays expected.
EIA reports slight uptick in Brent futures (+1.1%) attributed to Suez backlog; market consensus: transient.
